summary: Named only in a North Carolina lookout-tower list; no other source found describes a tower on this Transylvania County summit.

evidence.supports: The list names a Rich Mountain in Transylvania County
The row gives Transylvania County and an unexplained code, FB3115
The page is titled North Carolina lookout towers
The list was last revised in June 2021
The Rich Mountain Lookout is listed on the National Historic Lookout Register
That lookout is on the NC/TN state line in Pisgah National Forest
evidence.quote: Located on the NC/TN state line on the Pisgah National Forest

evidence.supports: That lookout is in Madison County

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. The only source naming a tower here is one row of the tnlandforms NC list (NCT145). That list calls its entries lookout towers, but nothing else found confirms a lookout stood on this Transylvania summit. One web search for Rich Mountain in Transylvania County returned only the Madison County Hot Springs lookout (us-nc-rich-mountain). Recommend holding this story or marking it unverified. Coordinates are from tnlandforms alone. The story is shorter than the usual 120-word floor because the evidence is one line.
